ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Setup.RES_Config_Switch__c.RES_Validation_Rules_Off__c), $RecordType.DeveloperName = "RES_Residential_Sales", ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Customer Approved"), ISCHANGED(Status),

ValidationRule.errorMessage: Quote status cannot be reverted to a previous stage once it has been Customer Approved
